---
title: "Layout panels"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrors: []
      printsMessage:
        # only the subfigure panel is unsupported; the plain one becomes columns
        level: INFO
        regex: 'subfigures .* are not supported yet; the subfigures are stacked'
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['div.columns > div.column', 'figure']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        # a plain panel maps onto emil.js columns, widths as bare numbers (A13)
        - ['::: \{\.column width="50(\.0)?"\}', '\nLeft \{\.caption\}\n', '\n\(a\).First \{\.caption\}\n', 'Figure.1: Panel caption\. \{\.caption\}']
        - ['width="50(\.0)?%"', 'ref-parent', 'layout']
---

:::
